   https://duckduckgo.com/api

2. DuckDuckGo Search API / Instant Answer API discussions and docs mirrors  
   Search results often point to community mirrors or GitHub READMEs that note there is no officially documented public web search API with published rate limits.

3. DuckDuckGo search library docs  
   Many third-party libraries that wrap DuckDuckGo search mention that rate limits are undocumented and that aggressive scraping may trigger blocking or CAPTCHAs.
